MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, meeting Sector Strength criteria; broad sector participation and positive Financials and Industrials returns support the supplied regime despite Technology weakness. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5); style mixed, no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads (+3.45% 1W), with GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and RCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%). Materials (+2.88%) and Healthcare (+2.26%) follow, led by PPG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is the clear laggard (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M), with GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%). Communication is nearly flat (+0.04% 1W), while Energy is modestly positive (+0.41%); TMUS is in RECOVERY (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) and XOM is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +14.30%).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), RCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), and PPG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5), neither narrowly concentrated nor broad across four sectors.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -33.87% | 1M: -23.69%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%), and BA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%). Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), and RCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%). TMUS is in RECOVERY (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%); monitor for follow-through, while SHOP is in CORRECTION (1W: -6.63% | 1M: +5.63%).

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 4.05% over 1W and 6.51% over 1M; GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%), and NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%). AAPL is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%); stock-level positive breadth counts were not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Positive but measured: Financials gained 0.96% over 1W and 4.15% over 1M, with JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%), and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%). Sector stock-level breadth counts were not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Strong, with the sector up 2.26% over 1W and 10.22% over 1M; LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%). UNH is in CORRECTION (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%); stock-level positive breadth counts were not provided.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor participation across sectors showing strength, while keeping exposure to Technology weakness measured; monitor GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), and track the tech trend in GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%). Style: mixed, no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) if gains persist after its buyback and privacy headlines; GD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%) if raised guidance continues to support momentum. BEARISH: BA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) if weakness persists; GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) remains at risk absent stabilization.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.26%; 1M: +10.22%) and Materials (1W: +2.88%; 1M: +9.05%), both with positive sector-level performance across the reported periods. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.05%; 1M: -6.51%); monitor whether weakness broadens beyond the current sector decline.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied; monitor whether GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) stabilize, and whether GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) holds its recent advance. Trend confirmation in these names is the actionable trigger from the available data.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+75): raised full-year guidance after a quarterly beat; ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%), sentiment confirmed. XOM (+75): announced planned 2027 buybacks; ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +14.30%), sentiment confirmed. CRH (+75): resilient growth and buyback update; ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +11.15%), sentiment confirmed. GM (+60): buyback catalyst aligns with price strength, but its privacy settlement headline is a counterweight; ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-45): analyst concerns around cash flow; BELOW TREND (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%), sentiment confirmed. GM (-40): driver-data privacy settlement conflicts with the positive buyback catalyst; ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), sentiment-price divergence to monitor.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, with Sector Strength and Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5), and style mixed with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership. Relative strength is visible in LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%). Monitor Technology weakness and GM’s mixed news flow, alongside GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%).
